source: hand-authored fixture for issue #308 — not shipped data
description: The one shape in which the two injected channels can disagree about a COLLAPSED KEY. Levoketoconazole files two self-named allergy rules — 'levo', which carries a note and which an allergy recorded as 'Levocetirizine' reaches only mid-word, and 'ketoconazole', which carries NO note and which an allergy recorded as 'Ketoconazole' names outright. contraindicationFinding keys both on the substance (issue #146), so they are ONE chip and one rendered clause, while each rule is put to the chart on its own token: the first is uncorroborated and the second is corroborated. They also TIE on rank — contraindicationRank answers SELF_NAMED_RULE_MATCHED_BY_CONTAINMENT_ALONE for the first and SELF_NAMED_RULE_WITHOUT_A_NOTE for the second, both 0 — so the ledger's incumbent-keeps tiebreak leaves the noted rule's sentence standing, and the rule ORDER here is deliberate: the uncorroborated one is authored first so it is the incumbent. Before issue #308 resolved the key as a MAX, the record said 'Recorded for this patient' while the finding beside it said the module could not corroborate the match. The second entry exists only so 'Ketoconazole' resolves to a substance that is NOT this one, which is what keeps the corroboration of rule two a leg-1 answer rather than a leg-2 one. No entry carries ATC codes, so no class comparison can chip.
